title: Krita ABR File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-134036)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Krita's ABR file parsing functionality. This flaw allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code by supplying a malicious ABR file. Exploitation requires user interaction, such as opening a crafted file or visiting a malicious page. The vulnerability arises from improper validation of the length of user-supplied data before copying it to a heap buffer.
